rows.why: The Offshore Pump draws water from a source block beside it (ADR-0050). No recipe makes water.
A Pumpjack on an oil well yields crude each cycle (ADR-0081). The wells are placed by a Java piece, so no data file names the fluid.
The Boiler turns water and fuel into steam (ADR-0048). No recipe makes steam.
An iron ore block pays its drop from `OreResource`, and its loot table is empty, so no drop derivation reaches it (ADR-0041).
